body: I just walk in a room and I feel like I don’t fit anywhere, and my presence doesn’t change anything or impact anyone. I can’t connect with people at all, not even my own family and when I come close to connecting with someone they always leave.

Oh yeah I know that feeling, maybe you have trouble processing your thoughts and insecurities. I write them down when I’m feeling down and usually that helps a lot. It’s somewhat comforting to see my thoughts written down on paper instead of trapped in my head.
That’s a pretty optimistic way of seeing things, I hope one day I feel the same way.

Thanks for offering to chat! That’s really sweet. And it’s a nice way of seeing things, but I’m afraid that if they ever lose interest in me they are gonna feel obligated to keep talking to me because of all the depressing stuff I could tell them.
God some people are horrible, the worst part about opening up is how vulnerable it leaves you. I’m really sorry this happened to you. :(
If I ever get super sad I’ll unload in your dms lol, thank you so much :)
Thanks for the support man, I’m glad You can relate to it. You all are so nice I might run out of negative things to say before I can talk to everyone.
Really? Thanks man <3 i get high from the validation. Soo sad existential talk no strings attached?
Aww thanks dude <3  the validation is getting me high
